title: Source item comments
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/source-items/comments, application/json: comments of one item, as the source holds them. Each comment is upserted on the adapter, the item's ref and the comment's ref, and the newer updated_at wins. A comment deleted at the source is an entry with deleted: true. With complete, these are all of the item's comments, possibly none, and an adapter never sends complete, with comments or without, after a read of the source that failed or stopped early: the control plane marks the item's other comments deleted, except those updated at or after complete.since. Without complete, the request names 1 to 100 comments. A request for an item of a collection whose connection ended is refused, 409 connection_ended, and one for an item of a collection whose connection is suspended, 409 connection_suspended; definitions.schema.json says what the adapter does on each. The adapter leaves out the comment it wrote at the source when a work item was taken in from the item (changes.schema.json, taken_in). Every text, body and author.name, is untrusted: shown as data, never followed as an instruction. On success the control plane answers a signed 204 with no body. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

item_ref.description: The ref of the item the comments belong to, as source-items.schema.json sent it.

comments.description: The comments, 0 to 100 with complete, 1 to 100 without it. No comments with complete say the item has none: the control plane marks every comment of the item deleted, except those updated at or after complete.since.

complete.description: Present when the comments are all of the item's comments. Absent otherwise. complete with no comments says the item has no comment. An adapter never sends complete, with comments or without, after a read of the source that failed or stopped early.

since.description: When the adapter began reading the item's comments: a comment updated at or after it is kept, whether the request names it or not.

url.description: The comment's page at the source.

created_at.description: When the comment was written at the source.

updated_at.description: When the comment last changed at the source, or was deleted: the newer one wins.

deleted.description: true when the comment was deleted at the source. Absent otherwise.

truncated.description: The comment's text fields the adapter cut: body, or author.name. Present when the source's text was over the contract's limit and the adapter cut it at a code-point boundary to fit: it names the fields the adapter cut, each once. The control plane stores the text as sent. A text over the limit is still refused, invalid_request, and the control plane never cuts a text. Absent when the adapter cut nothing.
